answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 149127 Country: Pakistan Title: Is it right to say if we will remember Allah he will also remember us if we will forget him he will also forget us? Question: Is it right to say if we will remember Allah he will also remember us if we will forget him he will also forget us? Answer ID: 149127 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 654/622/B=6/1438) Yes, it is correct. Both these things are present in the Holy Quran. فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ [البقرة : 152] نَسُواْ اللّهَ فَنَسِيَهُمْ [التوبة : 67] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
